purpose: Teach: 寅次郎/ハーバード/義経/薩摩/アムステルダム/カタルーニャ/諏訪/福山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが寅次郎の映画を映画館で観られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Dad took me to see a Tora-san film at the cinema.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Looking into the middle distance. Quiet, measured pace. Voice carries the weight of a memory being held gently, not performed. Slight pause between clauses.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ハーバード大学への留学が夢だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and Grandpa had that dream of going to Harvard, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, testing tone—gently teasing under the tenderness. Slight rise of curiosity on the question. She's inviting him into memory-making with her, not correcting. Soft, intimate register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが源義経の伝記をご愛読された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father was devoted to reading biographies of Minamoto Yoshitsune.
lines.style: Gentle shift in focus. Still wistful, but more settled into the detail. Voice rests on the name. Slower still. The specificity of memory—what stays vivid.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、薩摩出身の方々と交流されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to spend time with people from Satsuma, didn't you, Grandpa dear?
lines.style: Light, knowing inflection. She's guiding him through his own history with affection. Not quite a correction—more like she's holding the thread and inviting him to follow. Warm and slightly playful.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアムステルダムに駐在された
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father was stationed in Amsterdam.
lines.style: Voice brightens slightly—a different memory, different texture. Still wistful, but with a thread of curiosity about distance and time. Steady, clear. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、カタルーニャ独立運動のニュースをご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and you were reading all about the Catalan independence movement then, weren't you?
lines.style: Gentle, almost amused knowingness. She's catching him—his eye for the world beyond home. Warm without condescension. A small laugh underneath the tenderness. Intimate and patient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと諏訪湖の御柱祭を見に行った
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father and I went to see the Suwa Lake pillar festival together.
lines.style: Voice settles into this one—it's a shared memory, not just his father's. Quieter, more present. Slight emphasis on 'together.' Breath of something precious in that pause. Wistful but grounded.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、福山雅治のドラマをご覧になってたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you used to watch Masaharu Fukuyama's dramas, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm close. Knowing affection—she's teasing him gently about this one small joy. Voice softens at the end, letting him off the hook with a smile in her tone. Intimate, patient, almost conspiratorial.
